# components/ui: stock spartan/ui helm components

The **unmodified** spartan/ui helm components Harbor uses, generated by the spartan CLI (style `vega`, see `/components.json`). The app imports them through the `@spartan-ng/helm/*` path aliases in the root `tsconfig.json`.

They are consumer-owned code, the way spartan/ui intends: part of this repository, not a package.

**Do not edit them by hand.** Spartan Native restyles them from CSS only (`@spartan-native/theme/styles` and `@spartan-native/helm/styles`), through their `data-slot` hooks. Keeping them stock proves the theme works on what real apps have.

## Add or update a component

```bash
npx ng g @spartan-ng/cli:ui <name>     # e.g. dialog, sheet, menubar
```

Then add its `@spartan-ng/helm/<name>` path to `tsconfig.json`.

Currently here (47): accordion, alert, alert-dialog, autocomplete, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, chart, checkbox, collapsible, combobox, context-menu, date-picker, dropdown-menu, empty, field, hover-card, input, input-group, input-otp, item, kbd, label, native-select, popover, progress, radio-group, resizable, scroll-area, select, separator, skeleton, slider, sonner, spinner, switch, table, tabs, textarea, toggle, toggle-group, tooltip, typography, utils.
